text:
samir: Quick Q 11 Im planning to take parental leave starting May 10, but Im hoping to do a phased return (3 days onsite, 2 days remote) starting 8 weeks after that. Whats the official process to request a flexible return and do we need an accommodation form? Also, any guidance on pumping/lactation room access?
jess: Hi Samir, congrats! You should flag the phased return on the leave form so People Ops and your manager can sign off. For accommodations (like extra breaks for pumping) we have a short accommodation form. No medical diagnosis usually required for lactation.
people-ops: Hey Samir 1 we support phased returns. Steps: 1) submit parental leave form (link below) with proposed phased schedule, 2) attach any preferred return-date notes, 3) your manager and people-ops will confirm. Accommodation form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/accommodations. Lactation rooms: availability map is at https://intranet.redwood/locations/lactation-map (we'll reserve a locker near your desk if needed).
payroll-bot: Short-term disability (STD) may cover a portion of pay during leave depending on your plan. Estimate tool: https://intranet.redwood/payroll/leave-estimator. STD claims need provider paperwork; voluntary company-paid weeks apply first then STD/paid leave coordination.
samir: Thanks. One more: during my leave is my mid-cycle performance review paused or moved? I dont want to miss career feedback.
jess: We typically keep the review on schedule; you and I can do a shortened 30-min manager check before leave, then re-open goals/notes after you return. If it overlaps your leave, we mark the review as "on leave" and schedule a follow-up. Talk to me and we'll plan a timeline so you get feedback.
samir: Appreciate it. Also we might need a short-term backfill for 6-8 weeks to cover feature work and oncall. How do I request a contractor and whats the timeline?
recruiter-bot: Contract request workflow: submit a contractor requisition via the hiring portal (https://intranet.redwood/hiring/contractor-request). Typical SLA: 5-10 business days to post and screen, +3-7 days onboarding. Provide JD + 3 sample tasks and access list to speed things up.
jess: @recruiter-bot can you flag recruiting to prioritize a 6-8 week SWE contractor for Samirs team? We need someone who knows our infra stack (Go, Redis, k8s).
recruiter-bot: Flagged. @karen from recruiting will pick this up. Please DM job spec and access matrix.
karen: Got it 1 Ill post a contractor job and ping you for the task list. Quick ask: can you confirm budget owner for short-term contractor?
jess: Budget OK from Eng Ops for up to 8 weeks. Ill forward approval.
samir: One last payroll nuance: I did some overtime in the 2 weeks before my leave. Does that get paid out when I go on leave or after I return?
people-ops: Overtime and final payouts follow payroll cutoff rules. If it's in a processed pay period before leave, you'll see it on your final paycheck prior to leave. If not, payroll will include it on the next cycle. DM @payroll-bot with the payperiod dates and they can confirm exact timing.
samir: Perfect. Ill submit the form today and add the phased schedule. Thanks everyone for the quick help 60a
people-ops: Reminder: submit any lactation room booking requests at least 3 business days before return so we can reserve space. If you want us to draft the phased return agreement (simple 1-pager) we can do that and route for signatures.
samir: Yes please, that would be great.
people-ops: Noted 44d Well draft and post to your HR folder.
